title: AWKUM Hosts Creative Art Exhibition Showcasing Students’ Talent
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, under the auspices of the
Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa College of Arts
, organized a
remarkable exhibition of
students’ creative artworks
. The exhibition showcased artistic works
produced by students from the disciplines of
Textile Designing, Interior
Designing, Fashion Designing, and Photography
.

On this occasion, the
Commissioner Mardan, Mr. Javed Khan Marwat
,
graced the event as the
Chief Guest
, while the
Vice Chancellor, Women
University Mardan, Professor Dr. Raziya Sultana
, and the
District Police
Officer (DPO) Mardan, Mr. Masood Khan Bangash
, attended the event as
distinguished guests. The guests were warmly received by
Mr. Fazal Sattar,
Principal, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa College of Arts; Dr. Tariq Mahmood, Director
ORIC; and Mr. Farhad Safi, Director Administration
. The honorable guests
took keen interest in the exhibition and highly appreciated the students’
creative work.

The Commissioner Mardan, Mr. Javed Khan Marwat, while commending
the students’ artwork, stated that the creative abilities of youth are highly
commendable and that such activities play a vital role in the professional
development and training of students.

On the occasion, the
Vice Chancellor, Abdul Wali Khan University
Mardan, Professor Dr. Jamil Ahmed
, presented commemorative shields to the
guests. A
tree plantation activity
was also carried out in the presence
of the university administration.
